semantics.note: Keeps the firm '70% or more' and 'more than 7%' wording and the source qualifier. The Bloomberg estimate he relies on is hedged ('likely about 70%'), but his own wording is firm.

evidence.note: Bloomberg republication with the $24.1B numerator and a rough $34B AI-revenue estimate, which gives about 70.9%. Bloomberg itself hedges this as 'about 70%', firm only on 'more than half'.
Microsoft-reported FY2026 total revenue of $331.8B. With e1's numerator, the OpenAI share is about 7.26%.
Different metric (infrastructure consumption) with an unspecified period. Its 65–70% range and 'around 70%' framing weaken the idea of a firm floor.

reviews.rationale: The 'more than 7%' part holds: $24.1B of $331.8B, both company-reported, is about 7.26%. The '70% or more' part is not shown. The AI-revenue denominator is a rough Bloomberg estimate built on a growth assumption, and Bloomberg calls the result 'likely about 70%'. A point estimate of about 70.9% from rounded inputs does not establish a 70% floor.
